title: DesignPrompt: Using Multimodal Interaction for Design Exploration with Generative AI
scope_note: 全文逐页规则筛查＋高相关证据页语义清点；证据链仅保留PDF原句定位，未使用旧表内容。
context_summary: This paper presents DesignPrompt, a digital moodboard tool that allows designers to use multimodal input (images, colors, semantics) to create and refine generative AI prompts. The study involves 12 professional designers and explores how multimodal interaction affects design exploration and expression.

chains.claim_quote: We evaluated DesignPrompt to gain insights into the following research questions: ● RQ1: Does using multimodal input to create GenAI prompts allow designers to explore and express their intents better? ● RQ2: Does revealing system interpretation of user prompts help users to produce results that are more aligned with their expectations? ● RQ3: Does interactive and controllable GenAI input let users perceive the system as more transparent and useful for de- sign practice?
